decisions.statement: A body is restated where the text inside its quotes moves and nothing else does.
The text a template holds between its expressions is text inside quotes too.
Each body is formatted before the two are compared.
A longer run of text the formatter rewraps is a restatement even so.
A run of text added or taken away is no restatement.
A change to a comment is no restatement.
A path taken away is no restatement.
A path that is not there yet is no restatement.
Only a TypeScript body is judged here.

definition: whether a change moves only the words a page states
